# publish: 2026-08-28T16:51:48.044Z (published)

# The PER-PUBLISH lines change on every publish. They are immutable CID URLs because the
# server hands the query table straight to DuckDB, which pins the ETag it first saw and fails
# every data tool the moment a mutable /ipns/ URL is re-pointed underneath a warm instance.
# The pipeline workflow applies them to the MCP deployment itself (`publish:apply-mcp-env`), and
# superseded CIDs stay served for PUBLISH_RETENTION_DAYS, so a missed apply degrades to stale
# data, never to a 504. Paste by hand only when that step is not configured.

# --- per publish: re-apply these two, then redeploy ---
# DuckDB reads this URL directly and pins its ETag for the life of a warm instance; a mutable /ipns/ URL breaks every data tool the moment the name moves.
